comment: Approved divergences for the v2-to-v3 parity harness (#673).
Each entry pins an observable v2-vs-v3 behavior difference to the exact
config key that produces it (boundary-wide), with a stated reason. Drift
on any key not listed here fails the harness. Intentional v3 contract
changes must be recorded here rather than hidden or normalized away.
An entry may optionally carry 'fixture' to restrict it to one fixture; an
outcome-level drift (<outcome>) is only approvable when the fixture is
named by at least one entry.

entries.reason: v2 normalized the api format case-insensitively (normalize_api_format lowercases before validating); the v3 contract accepts only the exact declared enum values and rejects anything else at resolution time.
Fixture-level outcome: v2 continues the review with degraded defaults; v3 rejects the input at resolution time. The per-key entries below pin every input whose handling changed.
Fixture-level outcome: v2 continues the review with degraded defaults; v3 rejects the input at resolution time. The per-key entries below pin every input whose handling changed.
v2 degraded an unrecognized ai_response_format to 'off' with an ERROR log and continued the review; the v3 contract validates the enum strictly and rejects the input.
v2 degraded an unrecognized verdict_policy to 'model' with an ERROR log and continued; v3 rejects it (strict enum on the typed contract).
v2 lowercased then degraded an unrecognized review_verbosity to 'normal' with an ERROR log; v3 accepts only the exact declared enum values.
v2 degraded unrecognized tool_mode values (including the removed plan_execute_* names, #304) to 'off' with an ERROR log; v3 accepts only off|native_loop and rejects the input.
v2 degraded a malformed or out-of-range ai_max_tokens to 8192 with an ERROR log and continued; v3 rejects it (integer syntax plus positive-integer bound at resolution time).
v2 degraded a non-numeric ai_temperature to 0.1 with an ERROR log and continued; v3 requires a finite number at resolution time.
v2 degraded a malformed tool_min_successful_requests to 0 with an ERROR log and continued; v3 rejects negative integers at resolution time.
v2 degraded an out-of-range repo_map_max_bytes to 12000 with an ERROR log and continued; v3 enforces the same 1..200000 bounds strictly and rejects the input.

Tier representation change: v3 resolves the primary tier's api format at config time (resolveInherited); v2 left it empty and fell back at call time (classification.sh PRIMARY_* resolution). The effective call-time value is identical.

Tier inheritance moved from call time to config time: v3 resolves aiPrimaryBaseUrl from aiBaseUrl in resolveInherited; v2 left it empty and classification.sh fell back at call time. The effective call-time value is identical.

Tier inheritance moved from call time to config time: v3 resolves aiPrimaryModel from aiModel in resolveInherited; v2 left it empty and classification.sh fell back at call time. The effective call-time value is identical.

Secret presence representation: v3 inherits the primary tier's api key from the primary key at config time; v2 left it empty and the transport fell back at call time. Secrets are compared by redacted presence only.

Tier inheritance moved from call time to config time: v3 resolves aiSmartApiFormat from aiApiFormat in resolveInherited; v2 left it empty and fell back at call time. The effective call-time value is identical.

Tier inheritance moved from call time to config time: v3 resolves aiSmartBaseUrl from aiBaseUrl in resolveInherited; v2 left it empty and fell back at call time. The effective call-time value is identical.

Secret presence representation: v3 inherits the smart tier's api key from the primary key at config time; v2 left it empty and the transport fell back at call time. Secrets are compared by redacted presence only.

Tier inheritance moved from call time to config time: v3 resolves primaryModelContextTokens from modelContextTokens in resolveInherited; v2 left it empty and apply_context_limits fell back to the global budget (identical effective budget).

Tier inheritance moved from call time to config time: v3 resolves smartModelContextTokens from modelContextTokens in resolveInherited; v2 left it empty and apply_context_limits fell back to the global budget (identical effective budget).

v2 inherits the Forgejo token from the GitHub token through the action.yml env expression (inputs.forgejo_token || inputs.github_token); the v3 loader does not inherit it. The #681 cutover must re-wire this fallback in the v3 composite env block; pinned here so the gap stays visible until then.
